evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Joanna: 'it might take about ten to fifteen minutes if this is a good time. Alright, perfect. And do you have any important concerns or instructions for this move that you also want us to discuss on this call?' — The time-box and promise were delivered, but the rep did not wait for an explicit yes before moving into discovery; she pivoted immediately to questions.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Not asked. Joanna moved directly into logistics probing (bedroom furniture, living room furniture, etc.) without first asking 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?'
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A — No concerns were raised by the customer during the call, so there was nothing to follow up on.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: N/A — No concerns were raised, so no reflection was required.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (one-bedroom apartment), floor (ground floor), rooms (bedroom, living room), walking distance (150 feet), special considerations (six-piece sectional, glass TV stand doors, bedroom mirror, limited parking at current unit vs. accessible parking at destination), additional stops (none). All seven logistics categories covered.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Joanna provided typical range ('Usually a one bedroom apartment usually takes two and a half to three and a half hours') and personalized it to this customer's move (added time for walking portion from source address). Range given: $714 (at 3.5 hours) to $918 (at 4.5 hours). Full.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Joanna disclosed trip fee, assembly/reassembly fees, transportation fees, and mentioned two-and-a-half-hour minimum with 15-minute increments. She also stated 'no hidden fees of any type.' Full transparency and commitment framing present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Not asked. After giving the estimate range, Joanna immediately said 'Yup. So if that being said would you like our help with this move' — no pause, no 'Does that feel fair?' check, no silence.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Joanna stated: 'lastly on time guarantee if we run late we provide discounts by the end of the day.' Discount terms stated plainly, though brief. Full.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Joanna covered the $2,000 limit ('we a quote up to $2,000 coverage for this move for any accidental damages'), the no-deductible framing ('with us, again, we a quote up to $2,000 coverage'), and that it's included ('we also include other features like our no worries, damage coverage'). Full.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Joanna did not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or confirm the two promises were understood. She moved straight from the damage coverage explanation into the booking ask.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Joanna asked: 'Alright, anything else any other questions you might have?' — This is a throwaway 'any questions' formula, not the genuine 'What's still concerning you about this move?' version.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Not asked. No version of 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' was delivered.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Joanna asked: 'would you like our help with this move and we can already put you on the schedule.' No built-in out offered. Full.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Joanna stated: 'We don't take deposits at this time. The payment is only upon completion of the move' — rate commitment implied, though not explicitly branded as 'rate lock.'
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial. Confirmed: date (Thursday, October 8th), arrival window (9:00–9:30 AM), addresses (4950 Broadway, 8020 Windows Avenue, both Plano), apartment numbers (1151 and 125). Missing: phone number confirmation, crew size discussion, notes left with crew about customer concerns. Three of six items confirmed.

top_strength: Joanna conducted thorough logistics probing, uncovering all key details (property type, floor level, room count, walking distances, special items, and parking constraints at both locations) that directly informed an accurate and personalized estimate.
coaching_note: Section 2 (Their Agenda) was skipped entirely — ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move, and what do you want answers to on this call?' before any logistics probing, so you can surface and address what actually matters to the customer.
